# Carcavelos Daily Brief – Tuesday, June 16

**Small, clean morning glass turning choppy by afternoon—get up early.**

**Morning (03:17–11:00):** Expect 0.9m waves with light N winds (12–13 km/h) and smooth 5–6 second swell. Best window is **06:00–09:00** when conditions are most organized and the beach is quiet. Water temp holding at 17–19°C, so check your wetsuit.

**Evolution:** Swell direction shifts from NW to WNW as the morning progresses. Wave height holds steady around 0.9m, then bumps to 1.0m by afternoon. Wind picks up to 16–19 km/h from the north, creating chop.

**Afternoon (12:00–18:00):** Conditions deteriorate. Increasing wind (reaching 21 km/h by 18:00) kills shape, though waves nudge towards 1m. Not worth the effort after midday.

**Tips:**
- Go early—seriously, 6am start
- Shortboard in the morning; conditions favor snappy turns on small swell
- Avoid 13:00 onwards; wind chop takes over
